title: DORA Digital Operational Resilience Testing Programme
description: Schema for the resilience-testing programme mandated by DORA Art.24-25 (digital operational resilience testing). It declares the set of scenario CLASSES the entity must exercise (backup-restore, failover, DR-drill, dependency-outage, tabletop), each with a cadence, the last run (date + outcome) or null when never conducted, and the next due date. This is broader than the single A.10 restore-test: the restore-test (docs/runbooks/restore-test-log.yaml) is referenced here as ONE scenario (the authoritative log of THAT scenario lives in that file and is validated by check-restore-test.py; this programme only cross-references it and must not duplicate its detail). Validation of structure + presence of the required scenario classes + a cadence on each is BLOCKING; whether each scenario has actually been conducted in-cadence is asserted by check_resilience_programme.py and is HONEST: most scenarios are not yet conducted and the validator FAILs accordingly.

programme_owner.description: Accountable owner of the resilience-testing programme.

scenarios.description: One entry per resilience-testing scenario the entity runs.

name.description: Human name of the scenario, e.g. 'Terraform state restore drill'.

class.description: Scenario class. The required-class coverage is enforced BLOCKING by the validator.

cadence_days.description: How often this scenario must be exercised, in days.

last_run.description: The most recent run of this scenario, or null when it has NEVER been conducted (the honest seed state for most scenarios).

next_due.description: Date the scenario is next due (informational; the validator computes overdue from last_run + cadence_days).

evidence_ref.description: Cross-reference to the authoritative log for this scenario (e.g. docs/runbooks/restore-test-log.yaml for the backup-restore class). The detail of that log is NOT duplicated here.
